facts.text: 27 NOV 2026 2:52PM by PIB Delhi The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) and Ashoka University signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in New Delhi on 27th November 2026.
Rajesh, Additional Director General, Capacity Development Division, MoSPI, and Shri Sachin Sharma, Registrar, Ashoka University signed the MoU.

The MoU envisages collaboration across a range of areas, including faculty exchange, exposure visits, collaborative research, sharing of academic resources and publications, organising joint seminars, conferences and workshops, customised short-term academic programme, etc.
